habitat: Retro-gaming nostalgia posts and 'oldest internet memes' listicles, this one included.
diet: Feeds on a mistranslated imperative sentence rendered with total sincerity.
predators: None. No litigation has ever attached to the phrase or the screenshot.
transmission: Historically: song remixes and image macros of the game's opening cutscene. Today: text-only references, since the screenshot itself is not safely reproducible.
cause_of_death: The format simply aged out; nothing suppressed it.
resurrection: Referenced, not revived — almost always as a dated joke about a dated joke.
mutation: Extensive during its active remix period (2001-2003); none since.
prognosis: Set the phrase in the museum's own type. The screenshot is copyrighted even if the six words arguably are not.
curatorial_note: The text is short enough that copyright in the phrase alone is doubtful, but the screenshot is not. Set the phrase in your own type and skip the image.
